'''Dahm''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As the planet was invaded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Dahm suffered a terrible illness from the [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] gases that were unleashed by the Separatist's bioweapon.
